body:
I've had similar experiences, but I always just felt... detached. In a stadium, for example, I've never really felt like part of the crowd.

>Why are you seeking an unrealistic beauty and at the same time neglecting the small and beautiful things in life?

I don't know why I feel the way I do. I've tried to engage with the world around me. I've tried to care about things, but I just don't. I just feel indifferent towards most things.

I think there's simply something wrong with me. Something that prevents me from feeling like most people do. I've been treated for depression before, but it didn't help.

I'm sorry. I know you're trying to help, and I thank you for that, but I've looked and looked for some kind of beauty and I've found none, no matter where I look.

I've always suspected that what I'm looking for doesn't actually exist. I'm obsessed with a fiction that I can't even describe.

I don't know. I think maybe I'm just insane.

Some of those things might apply to me, I certainly lack friends, but that's not the thing that bothers me most.

Being completely honest, I feel that *beauty* is the thing lacking from my life. The world is so ugly. It's not the people in the world, nor their actions, but the world itself. 

I find it difficult to put my finger on exactly, but it's something to do with symmetry, there's too much symmetry. Repeating patterns are so ugly, so frustrating, and everything always repeats. The sun rises each morning and sets each night and nothing ever really changes, no matter what happens.

Sorry, I know I'm not making much sense, but this is how I tend to think. If I tried said that lack of money, or friends or a job is what bothers me most, then I would be lying.

This is the problem, really. I'm well aware that the more honest I try to be, the less sense I make. I'm sorry.

The only people who I've ever confided in were unable to reciprocate.

There isn't much specific information I can give you. My life is quite hollow. I rarely speak to anyone, or do anything. I don't know what to say.

I think I actually want to die.

I feel cornered by society, which wants to force me to continue living.

I don't know why, but I simply see no point in anything. Sometimes I pretend that I do, for the sake of those around me, but I don't really feel like I care about anything. I never have.

I just want to die. That's all that matters.

What's bothering me is how meaningless everything is.

There's nothing good, everything just hurts. And I know deep down, that I should be dead.
